params.question: Which colour do they want the background to be?

guide: Change the colour the screen is filled with each frame -- usually a BACKGROUND constant used by screen.fill(...).
report: I changed the background to $colour. $name is $new now.
$name is $new now, so the whole window fills with $colour each frame.
teach: screen.fill paints the whole window this colour at the start of every frame, before anything else is drawn.
_note: not_words: a background that is also things to see is Gary's, with game_object -- this recipe would set one colour and drop the rest. Measured on the 13C worlds walk (SPIKES.md section 28M): 'Make the background a black sky full of little stars, with a big purple planet' and 'Make it look like the deep sea: dark blue water, sand on the bottom, green seaweed and bubbles' were each made a colour change, the stars, planet, sand and seaweed silently dropped. None of the labelled change_background requests names one of these. Colour-like words (grass green, snow white) are left out on purpose.
